caption: The drawing depicts a tall, slender metal stand with a three-legged base that curves outward for support. Attached to the upper section of the stand is a fixture consisting of two cylindrical holders, each with a flat circular base underneath, likely designed to hold candles. These holders are connected to the main pole by curved arms. The pole extends vertically, ending in a small rounded knob at the top. The drawing is rendered in fine, dark lines on an off-white or beige background, with no additional colors or shading, giving the image a monochrome appearance. The overall composition centers the object vertically on the page, with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Rush and Candle Stand
